label: No candidate of the favourings considered is a present input in any scenario
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise about the carrier, attribution deferred: for every scenario s and every candidate x, x is not a present input at s. Intended application: the candidates are a root's possible products before production, none of which exists yet (the cognition criterion's own paraphrase records that at a root before production nothing is a present input). The present-input relation of the shared signature is not indexed by the bearer, so the premise is a global property of the candidate carrier: it is appropriate where the candidates are possible effects of the root and false on a carrier that includes present inputs.
